messages:
Sofia Martinez: Quick kickoff — we want the newsletter + webinar nurture to be micro and conversion-focused for the benchmark release. KPI: webinar RSVPs (primary) and report downloads (secondary). Thinking a compact 2-email invite (initial + 48h reminder) + 2 post-event nudges (recording + short highlights). Keep creative minimal to protect deliverability.
Owen Blake: Ill handle segments. Suggest 3 priority slices: 1) High-intent (clicked any product link in last 30d), 2) Active trials, 3) Newsletter general. For high-intent route users straight to AE calendar link after RSVP.
Hannah Liu: Subject test idea: emoji vs plain text vs metric-front. Examples: "4C8 Live benchmark: cost & latency revealed" vs "New benchmark: cost per token, real numbers" vs "Join our live walkthrough (register)". Run a 15/35/50 seed split on engaged subcohort and pick winner at 20h.
Deliverability Bot: Deliverability notes: use plain-text-first layout, avoid image-heavy hero, set List-Unsubscribe header, and ensure campaign subdomain warm for >=5 days. Seed tests: Gmail, Outlook desktop, Outlook web, and one ISP in APAC. If seed spam rate >0.35% hold.
Owen Blake: Segment filters (export-ready CSV logic):
```
high_intent: event_click_30d:true AND tag:product_link
active_trials: tag:trial AND last_event_14d:gte
general_newsletter: opt_in:newsletter AND NOT tag:customer
```
Owen Blake: Timing: high-intent -> Tue 10:30 PT (AE follow-up enabled), trials -> Wed 11:00 PT, general -> Thu 08:00 PT (split into two batches if >12k).
Hannah Liu: Cadence copy brief: Invite = 1-line hook + 3 quick bullets + single CTA; Reminder = 2 bullets (agenda + speaker) + social proof line; Post 1 = recording + TLDR 3 bullets; Post 2 = 5 highlight datapoints + download CTA. Use UTM: utm_campaign=bench_compact_launch, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content={{segment}}_{{variant}}.
Deliverability Bot: Suppression rules: downloaded_report_30d:true, unsubscribed_product:true, hard_bounce_90d:true, spam_trap_flag:true. Add throttling: if send_size > 15k split into chunks of 7k with 12m pauses.
Sofia Martinez: Operational nuance: for high-intent segment enable one-click register that prefills name & company. Use short prefill querystring, ensure privacy compliance. Also provide AE private RSVP token in CTA for customers.
Owen Blake: A/B hold rule: if variant B open rate < variant A by 10% at 20h, cancel B and send A to remainder. If close, choose variant with higher click-to-register.
Hannah Liu: Creative constraints: avoid subject personalization for general cohort to reduce token failure surface. For trials/high-intent we can personalize first name. Keep email width <600px, minimal fonts.
Deliverability Bot: QA checklist: seeds (support@, product@, 3 personal), test personalization on 200 random samples, verify List-Unsubscribe header, test ICS calendar add link, check tracking query length, run spam test on Litmus. Also verify SPF/DKIM alignment for campaign subdomain.
Sofia Martinez: Ops Bot  create campaign skeleton "Benchmark Compact Launch — Micro Nurture" and add tasks: segments (Owen), subject tests & copy (Hannah), deliverability QA (Deliverability Bot). Dry-run 4 days before send.
Ops Bot: Campaign skeleton created and tasks assigned. Dry-run scheduled.
Owen Blake: I'll export CSV filters and a 5% seed sample by EOD.
Hannah Liu: I'll drop invite + reminder microcopy into the campaign doc shortly. Let's keep language tight and action-first. :sparkles:
